description: This file contains test cases for message ID reconciliation logic within the ChatController component of an Android chat application. It defines unit tests to verify the behavior of the 'reconcileMessageIds' function when handling message identity across chat history reloads.

classes.name: ChatControllerMessageIdentityTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying message ID reconciliation logic within the chat application's codebase.

methods.name: reconcileMessageIdsReusesMatchingIdsAcrossHistoryReload
methods.description: Test verifying that message IDs are correctly reused during chat history reload when messages match by content and timestamp.

methods.name: reconcileMessageIdsLeavesNewMessagesUntouched
methods.description: Test confirming that new messages are assigned new IDs and existing message IDs are preserved during reconciliation.
